title: Anthropic sees junior tech hires' share fall from 27% to 9% amid growing AI adoption
hook_text: Junior tech hires plummet at Anthropic
script:
Anthropic just cut its junior tech hiring share from twenty-seven percent to nine percent.
This shift follows the company's increased reliance on its Claude models for internal tasks.
The company now leans on senior engineers to manage AI-driven workflows.
This change happened rapidly over the last year as AI adoption accelerated.
Junior roles previously made up over a quarter of the engineering headcount.
Does this mean entry-level tech jobs are disappearing for good?
